limits: Requires a new main-thread worker to enter the context; existing workers and frozen experiments are not changed or repaired by merely adding this file.
Scope owns the process alarm and intentionally does not preserve an independently armed enclosing timer.
Does not restore missing past receipts or exact unknown usage and does not guarantee recording after SIGKILL or filesystem failure.
